subject: Annual Prepay — FX hedging, mid-year true-up & escrow onboarding
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@summitanalytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ava Li <ava.li@summitanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Annual prepay — proposal questions (VAT / FX / escrow)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough — Summit is excited to move toward a committed annual prepay. Before we lock the PO, finance has three items they need your help on so we can finalize internal approvals: 

1) FX exposure — our treasury wants a recommended approach. We pay in EUR but Redwood invoices in USD. Can Redwood provide an optional EUR-denominated invoice schedule or a simple FX hedge addendum?

2) VAT / tax evidence — we need a sample invoice flow (VAT vs reverse-charge) and a checklist of docs your tax team needs for reclaiming. We're in Ireland; our tax differs from a UK/EU mix and procurement wants clarity.

3) Escrow/collection routing — we prefer funds held in an escrow account until monthly drawdowns are triggered. Do you have an escrow partner and a standard onboarding packet?

Attached is our internal timeline; happy to hop on a call but wanted to get these items in email.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
CFO | Summit Analytics
liam@summitanalytics.com

Attachment: summit-prepay-timeline.pdf (stub)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@summitanalytics.com>
Cc: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — proposal questions (VAT / FX / escrow)

Hi Liam — great to hear Summit is ready to move forward. Answers below and next steps attached.

Short summary (high level):
- FX: We can issue EUR-denominated invoices for committed prepay via our finance team; alternatively we offer an FX addendum with a monthly true-up at a mutually agreed rate (we typically reference WM/ECB mid-rate + 20 bps). If you prefer a hedge, we can add a clause in the addendum and recommend a monthly reprice window.
- VAT: For an Irish entity we typically apply the reverse-charge; we will need your VAT registration, a copy of the PO, and the billing contact. For any reclaimed local VAT (rare for our hosted service), we'll provide the invoice and supporting consumption report.
- Escrow: We work with third-party escrow partners (EscrowTrust is our standard). We can route the initial prepay into escrow with monthly drawdown triggers to Redwood. I attached our onboarding packet and a draft prepay schedule for your review.

What I'm attaching:
- prepay-schedule-proposal.xlsx (draft tranche schedule, currency options, proposed monthly drawdown amounts)
- escrow-onboarding-instructions.pdf (partner details + required KYC set)
- prepay-addendum-draft.docx (legal draft for FX clause + mid-year true-up)

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm EUR invoice vs USD + FX addendum preference by Tue 11 May.
2) Provide VAT registration + PO so we can issue the first invoice and populate the escrow agreement.
3) If acceptable, we'll send a DocuSign for the prepay addendum and an Ops ticket to set up the drawdown webhook to your escrow.

Looping in Kim (Finance) and Marcus (Sales Ops) to confirm timing and any quota triggers.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0128

Attachment: prepay-schedule-proposal.xlsx (stub)
Attachment: escrow-onboarding-instructions.pdf (stub)
Attachment: prepay-addendum-draft.docx (stub)

From: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:28:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Annual Prepay — FX hedging, mid-year true-up & escrow onboarding

Thanks Steph — quick internal notes so we can reply to Summit with concrete asks: 

VAT/tax:
- For an Irish VAT-registered customer we apply reverse charge on the invoice; we need the VAT number + legal billing name and PO. If they request Redwood to invoice in EUR, we will still note USD unit pricing internally but issue the EUR invoice using the agreed monthly conversion.
- Evidence we provide: invoice (PDF), monthly usage ledger (CSV), and signed PO. If they request tax residency attestation, we can provide our standard consumer-facing VAT letter.

Escrow / collection ops:
- EscrowTrust onboarding requires: bank authorization form, KYC for payer org, and designated webhook endpoint (we'll provide sample).
- Drawdown model we recommend: monthly fixed drawdowns with quarterly true-up (reduces FX noise). If they'd like quarterly fixed instead, note it reduces our ability to achieve per-token cost targets; call that out in SOW.

Marcus — can you confirm the drawdown amounts in Steph's spreadsheet and whether we should offer EUR invoices as a standard option for this deal? Also confirm the DocuSign timeline for the addendum.

Kim Park
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: none

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@summitanalytics.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Annual Prepay — FX hedging, mid-year true-up & escrow onboarding

Hi Liam — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few operational items and confirmation so we can get DocuSign and escrow set up this week: 

- We can set the drawdown cadence to monthly with a quarterly true-up window (months 3, 6, 9, 12) — this is our standard for EUR customers who want to limit FX churn.
- If you prefer to hedge externally, we'll provide an EUR invoice schedule and leave FX risk with Summit; otherwise accept our FX addendum (monthly mid-rate + 20 bps) and we'll run an automated true-up.
- ICO: please provide VAT number (format IE#########), PO number, and preferred billing contact.
- Escrow: we'll route initial funds to EscrowTrust (instructions in the doc). To onboard, please: (1) sign the escrow agreement PDF we will send, (2) return the bank authorization form, (3) provide webhook URL for drawdown notifications.

I attached the prepay addendum draft with a marked section where we add the FX hedge language. Once you confirm, Stephanie will issue a DocuSign and Kim will prepare the EUR invoice sample for legal.

If all good, we target: DocuSign out Wed 12 May, escrow account live by Mon 17 May, first drawdown on Tue 1 Jun.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: prepay-addendum-draft.docx (updated stub)
